paper.title_en: Light Ring Stability Across Spacetime Dimensions and Theories of Gravity
paper.abstract_en: The light ring theorem states that four-dimensional stationary, axisymmetric, horizonless ultracompact objects (UCOs) possess light rings (LRs) in pairs, one of which is stable if the Null Energy Condition (NEC) holds in General Relativity (GR). The existence of a stable LR may trigger nonlinear spacetime instabilities, thereby raising questions about the viability of UCOs as long-lived black hole mimickers. We extend the LR existence and stability theorem beyond four-dimensional GR to modified gravity theories, in particular, $f(R)$ gravity, scalar-tensor theories, restricted Horndeski gravity and Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity, in ($d \geq 4$) dimensional spacetimes. Our findings show that in four-dimensional modified gravities, the stability of LRs is governed by theory-specific coupling parameters in addition to the NEC. Consequently, a stable LR is not guaranteed to occur in certain parameter regimes. In higher dimensions ($d>4$), we confirm using topological arguments that LRs still emerge in pairs; however, the topological charges are now associated with four distinct types of LRs, including two types of saddle points. The stability analysis further constrains the allowed LR pairings, implying that, unlike in four-dimensional GR, the emergent pair does not necessarily include a stable LR. Our findings directly impact tests of GR using UCOs, demonstrating that LR stability is highly sensitive to both the underlying gravitational theory and spacetime dimensionality.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文对多个修改引力理论（f(R)、标量-张量、Horndeski、EGB）及高维时空中的光环存在性与稳定性定理进行推广，理论深度较高，并给出对UCO检验GR的影响，属于修改引力主题的实质性理论工作。
decision.title_zh: 跨时空维度与引力理论的光环稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 光环定理指出，在广义相对论（GR）中，若零能量条件（NEC）成立，则四维稳态、轴对称、无视界超致密天体（UCO）成对地拥有光环（LR），其中一个是稳定的。稳定LR的存在可能触发非线性时空不稳定性，从而对UCO作为长寿命黑洞模仿者的可行性提出疑问。我们将LR存在性与稳定性定理从四维GR推广到修改引力理论，特别是$f(R)$引力、标量-张量理论、受限Horndeski引力和Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet（EGB）引力，在（$d \geq 4$）维时空中。我们的结果表明，在四维修改引力中，LR的稳定性除了由NEC决定外，还受理论特定耦合参数支配。因此，在某些参数范围内，稳定LR并不保证会出现。在更高维（$d>4$）中，我们利用拓扑论证确认LR仍然成对出现；然而，拓扑荷现在与四种不同类型的LR相关联，包括两类鞍点。稳定性分析进一步限制了允许的LR配对，这意味着与四维GR不同，涌现出的配对不一定包含稳定LR。我们的发现直接影响利用UCO检验GR，表明LR稳定性对底层引力理论和时空维度都高度敏感。
